page.overview:
What is Bridge City of Telemar?

The Bridge City of Telemar connected the Isle of Corundis with mainland Corondor on Dominaria.

Telemar was the birthplace of Gwendolyn Carthalion. Originally it was built as a fort to defend the island, but it grew into a city over the years. Eventually even House Sapphire moved to Telemar.

In the unpublished comic Planeswalkers War, Telemar was destroyed when Leshrac activated the Grey Chime.
